record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, to Jeduthun<WH03038>, A Psalm<WH04210> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> I cried<WH06817><WTH8799> unto God<WH0430> with my voice<WH06963>, <FI>even<Fi> unto God<WH0430> with my voice<WH06963>; and he gave ear<WH0238><WTH8689> unto me. <RF>of: or, for<Rf>

In the day<WH03117> of my trouble<WH06869> I sought<WH01875><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136>: my sore<WH03027> ran<WH05064><WTH8738> in the night<WH03915>, and ceased<WH06313><WTH8799> not: my soul<WH05315> refused<WH03985><WTH8765> to be comforted<WH05162><WTH8736>. <RF>sore: Heb. hand<Rf>
I remembered<WH02142><WTH8799> God<WH0430>, and was troubled<WH01993><WTH8799>: I complained<WH07878><WTH8799>, and my spirit<WH07307> was overwhelmed<WH05848><WTH8691>. Selah<WH05542>.
Thou holdest<WH0270><WTH8804> mine eyes<WH05869> waking<WH08109>: I am so troubled<WH06470><WTH8738> that I cannot speak<WH01696><WTH8762>.
I have considered<WH02803><WTH8765> the days<WH03117> of old<WH06924>, the years<WH08141> of ancient times<WH05769>.

I call to remembrance<WH02142><WTH8799> my song<WH05058> in the night<WH03915>: I commune<WH07878><WTH8799> with mine own heart<WH03824>: and my spirit<WH07307> made diligent search<WH02664><WTH8762>.
Will the Lord<WH0136> cast off<WH02186><WTH8799> for ever<WH05769>? and will<WH03254><WTH8686> he be favourable<WH07521><WTH8800> no more?

Is his mercy<WH02617> clean gone<WH0656><WTH8804> for ever<WH05331>? doth <FI>his<Fi> promise<WH0562> fail<WH01584><WTH8804> for evermore<WH01755><WH01755>? <RF>for evermore: Heb. to generation and generation?<Rf>
Hath God<WH0410> forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> to be gracious<WH02589><WTH8800>? hath he in anger<WH0639> shut up<WH07092><WTH8804> his tender mercies<WH07356>? Selah<WH05542>.
And I said<WH0559><WTH8799>, This <FI>is<Fi> my infirmity<WH02470><WTH8763>: <FI>but I will remember<Fi> the years<WH08141> of the right hand<WH03225> of the most High<WH05945>.<CM>
I will remember<WH02142><WTH8799><WTH8675><WH02142><WTH8686> the works<WH04611> of the LORD<WH03050>: surely I will remember<WH02142><WTH8799> thy wonders<WH06382> of old<WH06924>.
I will meditate<WH01897><WTH8804> also of all thy work<WH06467>, and talk<WH07878><WTH8799> of thy doings<WH05949>.
Thy way<WH01870>, O God<WH0430>, <FI>is<Fi> in the sanctuary<WH06944>: who <FI>is so<Fi> great<WH01419> a God<WH0410> as <FI>our<Fi> God<WH0430>?
Thou <FI>art<Fi> the God<WH0410> that doest<WH06213><WTH8802> wonders<WH06382>: thou hast declared<WH03045><WTH8689> thy strength<WH05797> among the people<WH05971>.
Thou hast with <FI>thine<Fi> arm<WH02220> redeemed<WH01350><WTH8804> thy people<WH05971>, the sons<WH01121> of Jacob<WH03290> and Joseph<WH03130>. Selah<WH05542>.

The waters<WH04325> saw<WH07200><WTH8804> thee, O God<WH0430>, the waters<WH04325> saw<WH07200><WTH8804> thee; they were afraid<WH02342><WTH8799>: the depths<WH08415> also were troubled<WH07264><WTH8799>.

The clouds<WH05645> poured out<WH02229><WTH8776> water<WH04325>: the skies<WH07834> sent out<WH05414><WTH8804> a sound<WH06963>: thine arrows<WH02687> also went abroad<WH01980><WTH8691>. <RF>poured...: Heb. were poured forth with water<Rf>

The voice<WH06963> of thy thunder<WH07482> <FI>was<Fi> in the heaven<WH01534>: the lightnings<WH01300> lightened<WH0215><WTH8689> the world<WH08398>: the earth<WH0776> trembled<WH07264><WTH8804> and shook<WH07493><WTH8799>.
Thy way<WH01870> <FI>is<Fi> in the sea<WH03220>, and thy path<WH07635> in the great<WH07227> waters<WH04325>, and thy footsteps<WH06119> are not known<WH03045><WTH8738>.
Thou leddest<WH05148><WTH8804> thy people<WH05971> like a flock<WH06629> by the hand<WH03027> of Moses<WH04872> and Aaron<WH0175>.<CM>
